## Product Description & Utility

This tool enables restaurant owners, cafe operators, and bar managers to instantly convert paper menu images or PDFs into contactless digital QR codes without registering or paying fees.

### Core Functionality & Workflow

1. **Upload Menu File**: Drag and drop or click to upload menu images (Supported: JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF | Max File Size: 10MB).
2. **Cloudflare R2 Hosting**: Menu files are stored securely on encrypted Cloudflare R2 object storage to generate a reliable public URL for customer scans.
3. **Local Customization**: Store logo overlays and QR matrix styling are rendered 100% client-side inside the user's browser Canvas.
4. **Scan to View**: Customers scan the code with any smartphone camera (iOS/Android) to view the menu image instantly.

---

## Technical Details & Architecture

- **Architecture**: Hybrid Model — Client-Side Canvas Rendering + Cloudflare R2 Media Hosting.
- **Data Privacy**: No user credentials, behavioral tracking, or personal contact data logged.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Deployed on Vercel with GitHub CI/CD automation; assets served via Cloudflare global CDN.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: Are uploaded menu images saved on a server?
A: Yes. Menu files are stored on high-performance Cloudflare R2 storage solely to provide a scannable public link for your restaurant customers. Logo rendering and QR creation happen strictly within your local browser memory.

### Q: Can I edit the menu text or prices using this tool?
A: No. This tool is a file-to-QR converter for pre-designed menu images or PDFs. It is not an interactive digital menu editor.

### Q: Is there any fee or usage limit?
A: No, the service is 100% free with unlimited generation and no user registration required.
